records.entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
records.detail: The Central Bank of Lesotho's audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 classify the Bank's United States holdings of treasury notes and bonds by who manages them. The credit-risk concentration table carries a row 'United States-RAMP' at M1,932,669 thousand immediately above a row 'United States-Internally Managed' at M1,610,394 thousand, with South Africa at M2,830,862 thousand, the three summing to the stated total of M6,373,925 thousand. The prior-year column does the same: 'United States-RAMP' M2,133,975 thousand against 'United States-Internally Managed' M978,028 thousand and South Africa M2,482,938 thousand, summing to M5,594,941 thousand. No narrative sentence in the statements says the World Bank manages a portfolio; the evidence is the contrast the Bank itself draws, since a holding it labels RAMP and sets against one it labels internally managed is not internally managed. The same statements also list 'Bank of N.Y (RAMP)', 'Crown Agents' and 'World Bank RAMP' as counterparties elsewhere, which earlier rounds read and declined to file because no row distinguished management. This record is filed on the same footing as Mongolia's, where a line named for an arrangement rather than for an issuer was read as a separately managed account, and it is the stronger of the two because the contrasting row names the alternative in the Bank's own words.
records.source_title: Annual Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, credit risk concentration note (Central Bank of Lesotho)
